title: Fourier regularity from small influences
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ and $\epsilon\in\mathbb R$. If every coordinate has stable influence at correlation parameter $1$ at most $\epsilon$, then every nonempty set of coordinates $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ satisfies $|\widehat f(S)|\le\sqrt{\epsilon}$.
